description: This file defines the class 'Lines1', a snippet for drawing various styled lines using PdfSharp's graphics capabilities. It illustrates how to render different line types, including solid, dashed, dotted, dash-dot, custom dash patterns, and filled box placeholders.

classes.name: Lines1
classes.description: A snippet class that demonstrates drawing various styled lines and boxes using PdfSharp's graphics API.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides a method to render a sample of different line styles and patterns onto the provided graphics context.
